keyPoints: Har padarth chhote-chhote kanon (particles) se bana hai jo aankh se nahi dikhte, par unke prabhav roz dikhai dete hain.
Padarth ke kanon ke beech khaali jagah hoti hai — isi liye cheeni paani me ghul jaati hai aur sponge paani sokh leta hai.
Kanon me hamesha gati hoti rehti hai; garm karne par ye tez daudte hain, isiliye garm doodh ki khushboo thande se zyada door tak jaati hai.
Kanon ke beech aakarshan bal hota hai jo unhe jode rakhta hai — thos me sabse zyada, drav me beech ka aur gas me sabse kam.
Thos ka aakaar aur aaytan dono pakke hote hain, drav ka aaytan pakka par aakaar bartan jaisa, gas ka aakaar-aaytan dono badalte rehte hain.
Prasaar (diffusion) kanon ki nirantar gati ka saboot hai — itra ki khushboo bina pankhe ke pure kamre me apne aap fail jaati hai.
Aam galti: kanon ko chhoti gol gend samajhkar atak jaana; ye sirf samjhane ka tareeka hai, asal me ye kan parmanu aur anu hote hain.
